description: MYTHOS V1 delegation boundary over amElnagdy/delegate-skills (MIT, pinned b781ee2). MYTHOS does NOT implement delegation: it resolves a lane, writes a brief, invokes the vendor relay for the lane's implementer, and normalises delegate-relay.result.v1 into mythos.delegate.result.v1. Lane configuration is owned by delegate-setup (~/.config/delegate-skills/config.json) and is NEVER written from here. On any host where vendor_root is absent the layer disables itself fail-closed — a disabled layer is a normal, reportable state.
